subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Must this PR include the root-level denial of broad `sessions.subscribe` for `session-scoped-events` clients before the per-tab copilot feature can merge?
rationale: The feature promises isolated tab sessions, while the remaining broad subscription path can bypass that model; deciding to accept or close that boundary requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Integrate the root denial
options.body: Rebase or incorporate the narrow broad-subscription rejection and its real-gateway regression proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the feature until maintainers choose a broader session-subscription contract for scoped clients.

recommendation.title: Integrate the root denial
recommendation.body: Rebase or incorporate the narrow broad-subscription rejection and its real-gateway regression proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature branch owns the affected Gateway and browser-copilot contract changes.
